contract: RixPicks NFL anytime-TD slate v1 - one JSON object per delivery window
delivery: Sundays 8:30 AM / 12:15 PM / 3:30 PM PT via i2i; our side validates with scripts/ingest_nfl_slate.py (any violation rejects the whole slate) and publishes slates/nfl_latest.json

shape.window_label: display label, e.g. Sun 1:00 PM ET

kalshi._rules: top10 max 10 entries, prob 0-1, price_c int 0-100; bankroll_builder 3-5 picks from one matchup

validation: unknown extra fields are ignored; missing required fields, bad odds, bad URLs (https:// draftkings.com or kalshi.com only), or out-of-range values reject the slate - nothing partial ships
notes: picks only, no wagers; rendered above Futures on rix-picks.com as Wooder Ice picks, separate from the RixPicks card and record; slates older than 4 days render as the empty state
